function.name: get_best_sushi_places
function.description: Returns the best sushi places given the city, review_rate and top number.

city.description: The city in which to look for the sushi places.

top.description: The number of top sushi places to be returned.

review_rate.description: The review rating to filter the sushi places. Places with review ratings above this value will be returned. Default 0.00. This is a float type value.
